ideas.title: Offline-first Markdown notes with git-free sync
ideas.summary: Several small note apps are moving to local Markdown files plus a thin sync layer. People complain that git is too heavy for non-developers. A sync layer built on plain file watching and a merge-by-paragraph rule could fill the gap.
ideas.why_now: Two new local-first sync libraries reached 1k stars this month and a Hacker News thread asks for exactly this.
